lines.zh: 我挂在丛林的一片叶下
lines.en: I hang beneath a jungle leaf.
The vine sways, and I sway with it.
My cocoon is wound in fine threads.
The damp makes my casing shine.
I hang in the air, turning slowly.
I hang from a single thread.
Water drips off the leaf above.
My casing taps the vine.
I drift up and down on the warm air.
I turn to the leaf's underside.
Everything grows fast in the jungle.
I hang close to the leaf.
My silk holds firm in the damp.
The wind pushes me slightly aside.
Fine lines run over my cocoon.
I sway back to where I was.
I hang under the vine without a twitch.

lines.zh: 封在茧里，我什么都不缺
lines.en: Sealed in the cocoon, I lack nothing.
The jungle makes too many sounds.
Something inside is slowly growing.
My casing has hardened.
It is hot and wet here.
I am in no hurry while I wait.
A drop runs down my thread.
I hear a bird far off.

lines.zh: 我的壳上爬了一只小虫
lines.en: A small bug crawls on my casing.
I cannot see a thing.
I hang there, very still.
You have to look up to see me.
I hang above your head.
Do not shake this vine.
I have been here several days.
Are you going to pick me down?
It is not my time yet.
You smell of the jungle.
I cannot move, but I am watching.
Your foot is on the vine.
A while longer yet.
A crack appears on my casing.
I swing almost all the way round.
I hang lower.
The stirring pauses a moment.
I listen and stay silent.
I slowly check my swing.
My silk is taut as a string.
I am still hanging in the cocoon.
That little shock does not settle me.
I hang here and simply take it
I am in a cocoon; I do not eat.
That has nothing to do with me.
Take this thing away with you
Sealed in the cocoon, I cannot open my mouth.
Hanging it here will not help.
I lack nothing.
I cannot see it at all.
Move it further off.
I can't even be bothered to open my eyes
Just set it by the roots
You bumped the vine.
I swing harder than before.
My silk still holds fast.
Touch it again and I fall.
The bump slaps me against the leaf.
My casing strikes a branch.
My swing slowly dies away
A drop splashes my casing.
Do not rock that tree.
I spin a full turn before stopping.
I am sealed in my cocoon.
This cannot be discussed now.
Wait until I come out.
I cannot move a step.
I'm alone in this cocoon
I stay perfectly still.
Not a sound comes from the cocoon.
I still hang where I was, waiting.
Do not keep asking over and over.
My mind is a blank.
You have picked me up.
Careful, my casing is thin.
Where are you taking me?
One of my threads snapped.
The air here is too dry.
Do not squeeze me with your hand.
Something is moving inside me.
Hang me back on the vine.
I have a fine crack.
The jungle suits me better.
You are shaking my vine.
I hang here, but I remember.
Do not touch the vine again.
The one on this vine is me
What is inside is nearly ready.
You have disturbed my timing.
I watch your direction.
You just wait below.
I will remember this.
You had better leave soon.

lines.zh: 你的影子罩到我身上了
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen over me.
What is inside me has woken.
I stay turned toward you.

lines.zh: 藤的每一下晃动我都知道
lines.en: I feel every sway of the vine.
Something pushes from inside the cocoon
You still have not left.
I count the water, drop by drop.
I am still here, waiting.
It grows more restless in the cocoon.
The stirring grows louder.
One final warning.
Something moved in the cocoon.
I feel you still down there.
My silk is quivering.
A crack opens in my cocoon.
I jerk, and nothing more.

lines.zh: 茧里有东西撞了我一下
lines.en: Something struck from inside the cocoon.
You took one step back.
I have dropped a little.
One strand of silk snaps.
I am still hanging where I was.
The knock makes me quiver
Get further away.
Just a moment longer.

lines.zh: 我在丛林叶下结成一点
lines.en: A small point forms under a jungle leaf.
A cocoon appears on the vine.

lines.zh: 我吊在这里一点点变硬
lines.en: I hang here, hardening bit by bit.
Hot and damp here, just right.
I chose a thick leaf.
My silk has just been wound.
I have sealed myself in.
The jungle damp wraps around me.
I will be here for a while.
I go still, slowly.
Fire comes and my silk curls.
I fall from the vine into the brush.
Rain soaks right through my casing.
The blast shakes me off the leaf.
An arrow grazes my cocoon.
Magic makes my casing hot.
I was not eating anyway.
Lightning splits this great tree.
The leaf is gone in an instant.
